# Price Guessing Game

> Price Guessing Game (https://priceguessinggame.com) is a free daily browser game: bid on 5 mystery storage auction items, see the real prices, compare bids with players worldwide on the global leaderboard, and share your score like Wordle. New puzzle every day. No sign-up.

## Pages
- [Play](https://priceguessinggame.com/): today's puzzle, leaderboard and FAQ
- [Privacy](https://priceguessinggame.com/privacy.html)
